correctness.rationale: The six directed nonloop digram counts form an Euler trail on the bidirected triangle. One-letter counts recover the starting letter from outdegrees, so each observation equals a feasible arc vector with its starting vertex. Balanced flow differences a=b=c=t have three choices of starts except positive 2-vertex support (two) and zero support (three singletons). Six signed unit-imbalance endpoint pairs contribute 6A(z) with A(z)=(z+z²)/[(1-z³)(1-z²)^3]. Balanced contribution is 3B(z)-3z²/(1-z²), B=(1+z³)/[(1-z³)(1-z²)^3]. Summation simplifies to 3/[(1-z)^4(1+z)^2]-3z²/(1-z²). The coefficient at n-1 gives C_n and n³/8 leading growth. Independent brute-force word observations through length 10 matched all coefficients; the Euler-trail derivation is the unrestricted proof.
